Submitted. Summary of the repair:

- **Conformance qualifier removed** — "conform in all material respects to the specifications and documentation agreed by the Parties" became unqualified conformance of the Site, each deliverable and each item of software "to its documentation".
- **Software period corrected to preferred** — 12 months (digit-first) from the Company's written acceptance under Section 5.2, replacing the 90-day period.
- **Express 90-day Services period added** — the professional and workmanlike standard now carries its own 90-day warranty period, curing the official duration check.
- **Remedy trimmed to the three required limbs** — repair, replacement or refund at HDI's option; the non-required re-performance and 30-day cure mechanic were dropped for minimality.

All precision and minimality checks returned ok, and the locked `deviation` status was preserved with every preferred element mapped exactly once.
